popover.title: How are we calculating this number?
popover.intro: This number is an estimate based on the Smartlist and delivery settings at the time of calculation. The final number of recipients may change before the campaign is sent.
popover.listIntro: We calculate this number by excluding:

noValidContact.description: Members without a valid contact method
noValidContact.example: (e.g. no email address for email campaigns, no phone number for SMS)

optedOut.description: Members who have opted out of marketing communications (or are not opted in, depending on the campaign type)
optedOut.example: (e.g. no email address for email campaigns, no phone number for SMS)

invalidEmail.example: (e.g. addresses that don't exist or can't receive emails)

systemEmails.example: (such as temporary emails created by ClassPass)

smartlistChanges.description: Smartlist changes over time. Members may enter or leave the Smartlist between now and when the campaign is sent
